tweets.text:
Orchestrator offers automatic routing, available in preview.

It picks a model per request using profiles that map plain language tasks to models, then uses a decision model to match the conversation to the right route. https://t.co/2Pp1TExbFN

Orchestrator API serves 45+ models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, as well as open-weight models.

You can connect an existing OpenAI or Anthropic SDK to a Perplexity API key and all models can be called with OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses, and Anthropic Messages.
